rule_catalog.condition: natural_key occurs more than once in the ingested file
rule_catalog.description: Flags every source row whose canonical business key is duplicated within the same file.
rule_catalog.name: Duplicate natural key

rule_catalog.condition: provincia_norm or canton_norm is null or an empty string after deterministic territory matching
rule_catalog.description: Flags rows for which the province/canton normalization stage did not produce both normalized territorial values.
rule_catalog.name: Missing normalized territory

rule_catalog.condition: the non-missing normalized (province, canton) pair is absent from the versioned territory catalog
rule_catalog.description: Checks normalized territorial pairs against the local reference catalog; it is not a statistical range or outlier rule.
rule_catalog.name: Invalid province-canton pair

rule_catalog.condition: more than one distinct non-null estado_norm occurs for the same natural_key
rule_catalog.description: Emits one group-level event when records representing the same offer disagree on normalized state.
rule_catalog.name: Conflicting offer state

rule_catalog.description: Flags source rows with no institution name.
rule_catalog.name: Missing institution name

rule_catalog.description: Flags source rows with no academic-program name.
rule_catalog.name: Missing program name

excluded_features.canton_norm: Output of the same territory-normalization process evaluated by missing_territory_norm and invalid_territory_pair.
excluded_features.carrera_name_len: A zero length is a direct proxy for missing program name.
excluded_features.estado: Used by the conflicting_estado rule; excluded to avoid learning a direct input to the label-generating consistency check.
excluded_features.geo_method: Direct diagnostic output of the territory-matching operation used by the territorial quality rules.
excluded_features.geo_score_canton: Direct confidence output of the canton normalization operation.
excluded_features.geo_score_prov: Direct confidence output of the province normalization operation.
excluded_features.has_nombre_carrera: Deterministically reproduces the missing_nombre_carrera rule condition.
excluded_features.has_nombre_ies: Deterministically reproduces the missing_nombre_ies rule condition.
excluded_features.ies_name_len: A zero length is a direct proxy for missing institution name.
excluded_features.natural_key_token_count: Derived from the business key used by the duplicate rule and from fields participating in completeness checks.
excluded_features.provincia_norm: Output of the same territory-normalization process evaluated by missing_territory_norm and invalid_territory_pair.

feature_schema.interpretation: Predictive sensitivity to pre-audit contextual attributes after removing direct rule outputs and deterministic rule proxies.
feature_schema.name: leakage_controlled

method.threshold_policy: Maximize F2 on grouped OOF training probabilities over the predeclared grid 0.05..0.95 in increments of 0.01; ties prefer higher recall and then the lower threshold.

full_feature.interpretation: Rule-reproduction sensitivity analysis; it is not evidence of independent discovery of unseen quality problems.
full_feature.name: full_feature
